sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: MusicBrainz link previews follow a change made in Event Horizon at once: after a rating, a tag vote, an alias edit, a collection change or an edit vote there, the next card or window asks MusicBrainz again instead of showing what it kept for up to 24 hours (Keep MusicBrainz answers for (hours)). This uses the shared last-write time majkinetor's scripts keep in this browser (localStorage mbLastWrite, agreed on majkinetor/musicbrainz-userscripts #938); SAED only reads it. It applies to the entity cards, a release group's releases and facts, edit and editor pages and the paged lists of the windows. The Relationships column, recording lengths and "Recording of" keep their own lifetime, because no such change alters what they hold, and the external sites' previews (Wikipedia, Discogs, setlist.fm, …) are not affected.
